title: nan
authors: Han J.; Xiang N.; Zou D.
key_contribution: Presents a master-slave cross-domain (UAV-UGV) cooperative localization strategy for GNSS-denied environments using UWB ranging and EKF fusion, validated in field experiments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
